word.item: We had two ogres, these ogres loved each other, each one used to go and look for food.
One did not bring food, it wanted the other one's food, it ate for a day.
Now when the day came again they left and went.
This one when he did not bring food for almost three days, this other ogre told him no.
I will not live with you, when it chased him.
Then it rained heavily, that rain brought visitors.
It brought girls, three of them, they are from gathering firewood, they do not have a place to shelter, then they came and sheltered in this house.
The ogre was happy, the ogre was singing.
It has brought me friends, friends that I don't know.
Drizzling rain, has brought me friends, friends that I don't know.
Now that ogre was singing and those girls wonder, now how will we know what he is saying.
And yet it is happy while I don't look for food.
The drizzling rain has brought me visitors I will now get food, now it was singing, it was singing, it was singing while it rains, while it rains.
What that ogre did, when the rain was reducing it then told these girls, I want you to do what, you sit here.
You wait my mother has gone to look for food, she brings, we eat.
Even if it darkens, you will sleep here, I will escort you tommorow.
Now and these girls they got fooled, they just listened and stayed, yet the mother has not even gone to look for food.
It is waiting for it's friend that they live together, the one who has gone to walk, he returns so that they assist each other to eat these girls.

word.item: We had one woman, she had her four children.
Now these children of her, she liked sending them to the river they go and gather firewood, they bring back.
Now and these children when they were going, the ogre used to see them going and coming back.
They go and come back, now these children when they were going.
Then the children told the mother, we have seen something else here, an ogre is saying, I'm called Khase Khase.
So their mother tells them, it is called Khase Khase, the children tells her, mother, it is saying.
We go and do what, we go and gather for it firewood, and again we go and fetch for it water, then the child(it should be mother) tells them no.
That is a bad thing, it will eat you, Khase Khase is what, now the children were going, they were going.
Now when the children got lost, that woman said no, my children usually tell me they have found something here it says Khase Khase.
Now when that woman went she found that ogre.
She asked it Khase Khase have you seen my children.
And the ogre told her no, I have not seen your children, and she said no.
You usually tell my children oftenly to gather for you firewood, they fetch for you water, you know where my children have gone.
And it told her, I Khase Khase I don't know where your children have gone woman, and that ogre had taken those children.
It had moved, it had taken far.
And came to wait for this woman here.
While this woman was speaking, asking it, asking it.
This ogre what it did, it fell on that lady and killed her.
So that it remains with the children, for that woman not to ask it all the time, my story has ended there.
